div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 15px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #00294D;
display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #00294D; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: What changes when an A2A call goes through the Agent Gateway

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 42px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: The client swaps one base URL and keeps speaking A2A. The gateway becomes the agent server the client talks to, and the client never holds a credential for the real one.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 91px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 176px; height: 1px; padding-top: 141px; margin-left: 35px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 236px; height: 1px; padding-top: 141px; margin-left: 315px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Holds every skill it exposes, and its own credential.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 764px; height: 1px; padding-top: 154px; margin-left: 625px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Each client authenticates to the agent directly, reaches every skill the agent publishes, and leaves no record anyone else can audit. Revoking one client means changing the agent.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 239px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 188px; height: 1px; padding-top: 307px; margin-left: 35px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Unchanged A2A client code. It points at the virtual server and sends a gateway API key as its bearer token.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 808px; height: 1px; padding-top: 291px; margin-left: 301px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #00294D;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #00294D; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 232px; height: 1px; padding-top: 323px; margin-left: 313px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: A server to the client and a client to the real agent. It answers the agent card request and relays the conversation.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 232px; height: 1px; padding-top: 323px; margin-left: 585px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Decides whether this key may reach this agent at all, and which of its skills it may call. Access is granted per agent and per skill.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 228px; height: 1px; padding-top: 323px; margin-left: 857px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Every request to the virtual server is recorded, which is what makes agent traffic auditable and governable at all.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 216px; height: 1px; padding-top: 307px; margin-left: 1175px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Reached only by the gateway, using the credential you registered. Must be a public http or https endpoint.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 483px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 316px; height: 1px; padding-top: 511px; margin-left: 15px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: On the API Keys page, turn on the Agent Gateway toggle for the key, and enable the agents.invoke scope on any key that will actually call an agent.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 316px; height: 1px; padding-top: 511px; margin-left: 375px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Add the upstream server URL in the Agent Registry, then press Fetch Agent Card. That call reads /.well-known/agent.json and validates the transport and authentication schemes before you rely on them.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 316px; height: 1px; padding-top: 511px; margin-left: 735px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Choose which workspaces get the agent, then narrow access to the specific skills each workspace needs. A client should be able to reach the one capability it was built for, not the agent's whole surface.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 316px; height: 1px; padding-top: 511px; margin-left: 1095px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Replace the agent server URL in your client with the virtual one from the Agents tab:
Self-hosted deployments substitute their own gateway host. Nothing else in the client changes.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 643px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: WHAT THE UPSTREAM URL HAS TO BE

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 672px; height: 1px; padding-top: 673px; margin-left: 17px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Backend v1.16.1 and later apply SSRF protections to the registered URL, so the gateway rejects private IP addresses, cloud metadata hosts, and any URL carrying a # fragment. An agent running inside your own network has to be published on a reachable public http or https endpoint before the registry will accept it, which is worth knowing before the first Fetch Agent Card attempt fails.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 643px; margin-left: 723px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: NOT YET AVAILABLE, LISTED AS COMING SOON

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 672px; height: 1px; padding-top: 673px; margin-left: 737px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span: Access control today is per agent and per skill. Three finer grains are published as coming soon and are not available yet: access control for specific users, skill-level control inside specific workspaces, and skill-level control for specific users. Until they land, the workspace is the smallest unit you can scope an agent to, so plan workspace boundaries around who should reach which agent.
